description: Email triage — Triage an email for an inbox agent: category (action request, meeting, invoice, sales outreach, newsletter, support issue, security alert, spam/phishing...), priority (urgent/high/normal/low, auto-raised when a deadline is within 24h), intent, summary, action items with owner and due date, deadline, reply needed + suggested reply, entities, sentiment, and a phishing/fraud risk check (AI flags + offline rules for gift cards, bank-detail changes, credential requests). Optional subject= and from=. Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).

text.description: e.g. Hi team, the Q3 invoice #4471 for $12,400 is overdue. Please pay by Friday Nov 27 or service will be paused. Thanks, Dana (Acme Billing)

name: ai_email_triage
